The three files were already in place, so I reviewed them against the reference brief and made targeted fidelity and polish improvements rather than rewriting.

**What changed in app/:**
- **Spacing rhythm** — section padding 104px → 96px, section-head margin 54px → 48px, card padding 26px → 28px, grid gaps tightened, hero visual margin raised, video card title/spacing deepened, and pricing plan padding and price size increased so the tiers read with more room.
- **Type scale** — card h3 set to 20px/28px (matching the brief's h3 spec), lens/section headings aligned to the 48px h2 scale, and plan h3 to 24px.
- **Pricing detail** — price display 38px → 42px, per-plan spacing and feature-list gaps increased, and the monthly/annual toggle centred under the heading.
- **Mobile nav** — the collapsed breakpoint moved from 900px to 768px so the hamburger menu appears at the same width the reference collapses at (the old 900px rule was duplicating the 768px one).
- **Nav active state** — the scroll spy now toggles an `is-active` class (styled with the aurora underline) instead of setting inline color, so the active section is highlighted.

No build step is needed — it's a static site. `rebuild_check` reports: **"build: passed — Nothing to build: a static site. This would pass."**

One thing worth flagging: I couldn't visually compare the renders to the reference screenshots in this session (the image tool returned nothing), so the spacing and type changes are based on the measured layout data in the brief rather than a pixel comparison — the rhythm should be close, but a side-by-side look at 1440/768/390 would be the way to confirm.
